carry_forward_constraints: S38 must not treat S37 performance reports, budgets or same-result claims as validated. Only repaired machine-valid BenchmarkManifest/BenchmarkResult artifacts may be inherited.

Any S38 concurrency/resilience performance comparison must preserve the same fixture hash, code/config versions, stage boundary, environment fingerprint and artifact-specific equivalence oracle before and after concurrency changes.
Concurrency, retries or queueing must not bypass idempotency, checkpoint, privacy, reviewer/abstention routing or decision-policy semantics inherited from S26-S37.

Measure end-to-end wall latency and relevant per-stage latency/CPU separately. A wall-vs-process-CPU gap suggests waiting but does not identify network, lock, queue or scheduler cause without further instrumentation.
Separate cold-start and steady-state experiments. Do not discard startup/reconnect initialization time if it is part of the S38 user/operator SLO.
Do not share mutable cache state, benchmark fixtures or model/reference state across concurrent workers unless synchronization/ownership is explicit and tests demonstrate deterministic semantics.

Cache keys/invalidation must retain complete dependency lineage: data snapshot/backfill, feature/code version, preprocessing/reference, detector/policy and cutoff/as-of. Concurrency cannot make stale cache reuse acceptable.

Retries, batching, parallelism or async ordering must not silently change candidate/ranking order, tie policy, duplicate handling or human-review destination unless the semantic change is explicitly authorized and separately evaluated.
Checkpoint/restart/idempotency guarantees must survive a real process/store reopen and induced failure. Printed booleans or in-memory sets are not resilience evidence.
Performance budgets must consume finite nonnegative metrics produced by the benchmark harness on controlled/fingerprinted runners; hand-entered measured values are not CI gates.
Evaluate throughput together with latency distribution, error/timeout rate, queue depth/backpressure and resource saturation; a higher requests-per-second number alone is not a resilience win.
Chunking/out-of-core/concurrent partitioning must preserve every input row including remainder partitions; regression tests must catch zero/negative sizes and silent work loss.

Carry S37 regressions for same-result false green, blocking remainder/input domains, candidate recall, cache hit semantics, invalidation, chunk size, invalid budgets, zero/negative speedup ratios and missing pytest gates.
The current S37 Theory playground is an off-topic simulated dbt activity and is not evidence for profiling/performance behavior; do not benchmark or inherit it as S37 functionality.

Inherited S26-S37 debt remains active. Faster or more concurrent execution cannot legitimize contaminated data, leaked evaluation, invalid metrics, unsafe routing, missing lineage or non-reconstructible decisions.
